messages:
jordan: Mistral customer (mistral-db) request: rollforward their tenant to a dedicated slice tomorrow 03:00 PT. Need SRE + PM + security OK. Docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mistral-dedicated-rollforward :calendar:
kim: quick question — KMS rotation might collide with that window, right?
jordan: good catch. KMS rotation scheduled 03:30 PT on same day originally, I moved it to 05:00 PT. No KMS collision now.
deploy-bot: PRECHECK RESULTS for thread 1767234567:
- infra-available: OK
- quota: OK (reserved 4 nodes)
- model-pin: v1.12.3 pinned: OK
- kvcache-consistency: WARN (stale-prefix risk <1%)
- canary-route-ready: OK
Notes: see /ci/rollforward/prechecks/1767234567.log
lucas: can you confirm which model runtime is pinned? we should confirm quantization profile too.
jordan: pinned to model-server v1.12.3 with q4_0 profile. quantization profile set to q4_0-low-latency in tenant config.
anya: propose a 5% canary for first 30 minutes, then 25% for 1h, then full. rollback gate: 95th-p50 latency >200ms or error-rate >1.5% -> rollback.
ops-sam: acked for SRE side. I'll be on-call for the window. I'll run the traffic shift and manual rollback steps if thresholds hit. :thumbsup:
pm-ella: PM here — product approves the schedule contingent on security audit log enabled and SLA change notice sent to customer.
security-bot: SECURITY CHECK: Audit-logging: DISABLED
jordan: enabling audit-logging now (tenant-level) and will attach confirmation.
security-bot: SECURITY CHECK: Audit-logging: ENABLED (cfg id: audit-tn-7733)
kim: re: downtime — can we guarantee no primary downtime? customer asked.
jordan: no primary downtime expected. we'll do live traffic shift using weighted routing with connection drain.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Rollforward job created -> job_id 2026-1767234567-RF. Window: 2026-04-07 03:00 PT -> 03:45 PT (canary phases included). Operator: ops-sam.
lucas: what about DB migrations? any data-level ops?
jordan: no migrations. this is slice reassignment only. DB stays multi-tenant read path unchanged.
anya: confirm healthchecks: model_gen_success >= 99% and embedding-throughput within 5% of baseline.
ops-sam: added those as live metrics to the deploy template. will monitor dashboards + runbook.
pm-ella: I sent the customer SLA update and scheduled the pre-roll email for 24h before window.
kim: LGTM from infra/security side.
ops-sam: on-call + ops ack. I'll start the runbook at T-30.
deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED (job 2026-1767234567-RF) -> 5% traffic. health: OK.
jordan: monitoring thread will be #incidents-mistral during window, tagging @ops-sam and @kim.
deploy-bot: CANARY PHASE 1 -> PASS. moving to 25% for 60m.
ops-sam: monitoring: 95th p50 = 120ms, errors = 0.3% — within thresholds.
pm-ella: PM: GO for full roll at +90m if canary stays green.
deploy-bot: FULL ROLLFORWARD COMPLETE. job 2026-1767234567-RF -> SUCCESS.
security-bot: Audit logs captured. retention policy applied: 90 days.
lucas: spot-checked latencies, looks healthy.
anya: marking runbook step: "post-traffic-check" done.
jordan: thanks team — closing thread. Please file a short release note in the tenant's folder. :tada:
